Name: Person Number
Description: The person number of the person whose role information this is.

Name: Role Name
Description: Supply the common name of the role to be included in the update-role request.

Name: Person User Information ID
Description: Supply the source system ID value supplied for the PersonUserInformation record and add the SourceSystemId hint to this attribute name. Alternatively, supply the user key attributes.

Name: User Name
Description: The user name to assign the role to.

Name: Person ID
Description: Supply the source system ID value supplied for the Worker record and add the SourceSystemId hint to this attribute name. Alternatively, supply the PersonNumber attribute.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.

Name: Reference 1
Description: A user-defined reference value used for reporting and reconciling your data in the staging tables. This information is not saved in the application. You name your reference on the METADATA line using the format Attribute name = Reference name. For example, SourceRef001=Assignment Number.
